scope: Analysis only; minimal three reports, no source/native/stream/pilot
mechanism_difference: Original policies permanently removed a percentage of remainder. Proposed policy caps only excess leg notional relative to contemporaneous settled portfolio equity and creates at most one actual-fill-backed same-cycle restoration credit. This changes exposure duration and amount, not an established positive edge.
recommendation: May present as ONE concrete unimplemented hypothesis after specification freeze and saved-snapshot cap/cost summary. Do not admit native or claim superior expectation from current evidence.
critical_findings: Early SOL1 cap at N/W14.3245 would trim about72.51%, stronger than50% M1. Restoration may or may not preserve its profitable rebound.
Restoration above actual cut VWAP for long/below for short locks adverse roundtrip price difference plus additional fees/spread; favorable breakout is not free recovery.

32 original first-hit snapshots can assess original-path cap selection and indicative immediate trim costs, but cannot prove first eligible cap event, restoration candle timing, actual fills or alternative capital path.
Uniform3.9375 gross leg N/W is a convention derived from half existing BTCshort multiplier; it does not equalize BTC/SOL risk, impose portfolio cap or promise DD50.

W and N must be positive settled source equity and same-source held mark notional; target is fixed absolute quantity at claim, not ongoing rebalance. Quote move/gap/partialIOC can leave actual N/W above cap.

Restoration credit must be actual filled trim quantity, one same native cycle, consumed by actual restoration fills; canceled/rejected/partial restore is one attempt, not repeated percentage clipping.

Original-plan-remaining must exclude later ordinary TP/exit fills and already used restore credit; protective BTC restoration earns no SOL rights, SOL restoration does not reset consumed add notional. No reentry after cycle flat or ordinary forced terminal exit.

Define actual cut price as volume-weighted confirmed trim fills, finalize trim attempt before evaluating candles, use only fully closed post-cut15m candles and strictly earlier closed candle high/low. Existing prior/busy qualifying candles cannot be retroactively executed.
preliminary_tests_missing: Saved32 snapshot cap pass/skip counts by asset, original winners retained/affected, distribution of trim fraction and cap gross notional, partial-liquidity flags.
Separate assumed trim-only and trim-plus-restoration fee/notional/spread costs; missing funding signed amount stays UNKNOWN.

Restoration availability/first qualifying candle/wrong-way rebound tradeoff require already stored causal closed15m observations; absent these, explicitly UNKNOWN, not inferred from endpoint winners/extrema.

Before any separately approved native work, native fixture contract must prove cycle identity, fixed target/actual fill credit, once-only restore, closed-bar causality, ordinary-exit/unknownACK priority, no false rights or same-right refill, margin/minimum/rounding guards.
alternative_if_restore_entitlement_canno: Drop restoration and label one-shot equity-relative excess cap as an unproved risk-mechanism baseline; do not call it a solution. It is simpler but shares permanent-cut downside, so reject economic recommendation absent evidence.

appendices.remaining_specification_gate: Literal ANY ordinary exit intent may include pre-existing or routinely requeued passive BTC TP targets, immediately canceling restoration credit. Without this distinction temporary BTC mechanism may collapse to permanent cap. No silent policy revision proposed.
appendices.verdict: Concrete unimplemented risk-mechanism proposal may be presented for consent with this intent semantics explicit. It is not economically proven, not ready for native, and does not support50/90 expectations.
